seasons.description: Michael C. Hall and Brian Cox turn this New York hunt into relentless tension.
seasons.overview: Season 2 finds Dexter caught between two killers, one notorious and the other terrorizing New York in ways no one ever anticipated, all while battling his greatest enemy yet, a mid-life crisis. Harrison continues his own pursuit of justice as father and son face their darkest chapter.

seasons.description: Tom Hardy and Pierce Brosnan anchor a fierce crime finale already renewed for Season 3.
seasons.overview: In the second season, the Harrigans struggle to show a unified front as rising rivals threaten their fractured criminal empire – and Harry Da Souza, their street-smart and formidable 'fixer', must walk a dangerous tightrope when tensions within the family intensify. As violence spills into every corner of their lives, loyalties snap, safety proves temporary, and the battle for power leaves no room for mercy.

seasons.description: Climbing to #2 on Prime Video, Season 6 chronicles Jesus's final hours with emotional weight.
seasons.overview: The hour has come. Season 6 captures Jesus' final day through the eyes of those who love Him-and those who condemn Him. In the face of loneliness and death, He stands resolute in His plan that has always led to one place: the cross.

seasons.description: Dropped today on Netflix, Malin Akerman and Brittany Snow deliver delightfully messy Texas chaos.
seasons.overview: Sophie trades city life for East Texas and falls into a wealthy socialite's magnetic orbit — where a clique of housewives hide deadly secrets.

seasons.description: Yellowjackets begins its final reckoning with Melanie Lynskey, Hilary Swank, and mounting survival dread.
seasons.overview: In Yellowjackets Season 4, rescue draws closer to the teens’ wilderness location, but the survivors’ long-awaited salvation threatens to expose their darkest secrets. In the present-day timeline, an old flame has a homecoming of her own, returning to town with a hidden agenda. Happy returns? Not in the Yellowjackets’ world.

seasons.description: Ashley Jensen investigates a chilling island cold case during Alison O'Donnell's farewell season.
seasons.overview: Set against the stark backdrop of Scotland's rugged coastline, DI Jimmy Perez and his team investigate murders in the small island community of Shetland.

seasons.series_name: The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power
seasons.description: Prime Video's Middle-earth epic grows darker as Sauron's war against the Elves escalates.
seasons.overview: Jumping forward several years from the events of Season Two, Season Three takes place at the height of the War of the Elves and Sauron, as the Dark Lord seeks to craft the One Ring that will give him the edge he needs to win the war, bind all peoples to his will - and at last rule all Middle-earth.

seasons.description: Carrie Coon and Morgan Spector clash over high society in HBO's lavish Sunday drama.
seasons.overview: Bertha Russell changed Society at a cost. Now, her family must reckon with the consequences as Agnes van Rhijn seizes an opportunity to regain her position. Meanwhile, Marian forges a new path for herself, and Peggy works to be accepted by her future in-laws. In this new era, you must be careful what you wish for.

seasons.description: Walker Scobell leads a darker, high-stakes Titan's Curse quest streaming weekly on Disney+.
seasons.overview: The stakes are higher than ever before as Percy is faced with the sudden disappearance of Annabeth and the impending Great Prophecy provided by the Oracle of Delphi, dictating the fate of Olympus. As foretold by the Oracle of Delphi, one demigod child of the "Big Three" is fated to raise Olympus to new heights or bring it crashing into ruin, with their own life hanging in the balance.

seasons.description: Disney+'s record-breaking Korean fantasy romance just wrapped its addictive palace intrigue run.
seasons.overview: Beloved Empress Navier of the Eastern Empire has built and led a prosperous land alongside her husband, Emperor Sovieshu. One day her world is shattered when the emperor brings Rashta, a runaway slave, back to the palace with the intention of making her his mistress. But even as the threat of a broken future looms over her, Navier refuses to let her emotions sway her, and when Prince Heinrey, a rival leader of the Western Kingdom, shows interest in her, Navier will make a life-changing decision to rewrite her destiny.

seasons.description: Paul Bettany and James Spader headline Marvel's cerebral AI thriller with huge finale viewership.
seasons.overview: The Vision, rebooted and having escaped from those who sought to weaponize him, has been in hiding. Searching for new meaning, he consults the AI personas embedded in his programming, including Friday, Edith, Jarvis, and the infamous Ultron. His discreet existence ends when a bounty placed on his head thrusts him on the run with Thomas Shepherd, a mysterious boy who may be Vision's son reincarnate. As Vision evades capture, he must confront his nature, resist Ultron's influence, and unravel the enigma that is his young companion if he's to survive.

seasons.description: Keira Knightley and Ben Whishaw power Netflix's #1 global hit with 96% Rotten Tomatoes acclaim.
seasons.overview: Helen is still betraying her nation's secrets to the covert organization she serves: the Black Doves. But after the misadventures of last Christmas, and with her husband Wallace, preparing to become Prime Minister, she is walking a more treacherous line than ever.

seasons.description: Gary Oldman leads Slough House on the run in an acclaimed 100% Fresh season.
seasons.overview: In season six, the Slow Horses are on the run as Diana Taverner embroils them all in a fatally high-stakes game of retaliation and revenge.

seasons.description: Yim Si-wan and Seorina sparkle in Prime Video's twisty undercover office rom-com, now complete.
seasons.overview: 대한민국을 발칵 뒤집은 '캐비닛 살인 사건'의 유력한 용의자로 지목된 태강그룹의 후계자 윤이준 상무. 사건의 진실을 파악하기 위해 형사 강재희는 발칙한 계획을 실행한다. 이준을 밀착 감시하기 위해 여자가 아닌 남자로, 형사가 아닌 수행비서로 태강그룹에 잠입한 것! 아슬아슬한 동행 속, 사건은 새로운 국면을 맞이하며 잔혹한 진실이 드러나기 시작하는데... 사건이 진실에 가까워질수록 이준과 재희는 서로의 진심에 가까워지기 시작한다. 높아만 지는 심박수는 감출 길이 없고, 그 마음이 자꾸만 입 밖으로 새어 나오려 하니. 사건과 사심 사이, 이준과 재희는 위태로운 줄타기를 이어가는데...! 정체를 숨긴 재희와 비밀을 숨긴 이준. 과연 두 사람은 서로의 진심에 닿을 수 있을까?

seasons.description: Son Suk-ku and Eita Nagayama hunt a cross-border serial killer in Netflix's gritty thriller.
Ethan Hawke and Tommy Lee Jones shine in FX's acclaimed noir, wrapping last night.
seasons.overview: In a world where truth lies buried beneath layers of power and deception, season 2 pushes deeper into the cost of uncovering what others are desperate to keep hidden. As new conspiracies emerge, alliances fracture, and every revelation carries dangerous consequences. Ethan Hawke leads with quiet intensity, Keith David commands every scene with authority, Ryan Kiera Armstrong delivers striking emotional depth, and Mahershala Ali brings layered gravitas—elevating each moment with tension and nuance. Dark, gripping, and intellectually charged, the second season is a high-stakes drama about truth, loyalty, and the price of digging too deep.

seasons.description: Fresh off its sixth Emmy, South Park wrapped Season 29 skewering AI and gaming.
seasons.overview: Join Stan, Kyle, Cartman and Kenny for the historic 29th season of South America.

seasons.description: Sylvester Stallone defends his Oklahoma empire against crooked politicians in Paramount+'s crime hit.
seasons.overview: In season four, Dwight fights to legitimize his empire and protect his crew as corrupt politicians, dangerous new enemies, and a crushing personal loss hit from every direction. However, every hard-won gain comes with even harder truths: about loyalty, leadership and the cost of ambition. Each move drags Dwight deeper into the street instincts he left behind in New York - turning Tulsa into a battleground and Dwight into the one threat no one can afford to underestimate.

seasons.description: Florence Pugh commands Netflix's lush, moody adaptation of John Steinbeck's classic family saga.
seasons.overview: In the farmlands of the Salinas Valley in California, successive generations of two families, the Trasks and the Hamiltons, are destined to reenact the fateful story of Cain and Abel.

seasons.description: Kyle Chandler and Aaron Pierre bring True Detective grit to HBO's acclaimed DC mystery.
seasons.overview: Follows intergalactic cops John Stewart and Hal Jordan as they uncover a dark mystery.

seasons.description: Omar Sy's stylish Parisian thief outsmarts a daring copycat in Netflix's top non-English hit.
seasons.overview: After four years in prison, Assane is ready to start a new life with his family. But the emergence of a mysterious copycat forces Lupin to return to his most brilliant schemes.

seasons.description: Mike Flanagan modernizes Stephen King's iconic horror tale with a magnetic Summer H. Howell.
seasons.overview: After her father's sudden, untimely death thrusts her into the unforgiving ecosystem of public high school, Carrie is forced to navigate a viral bullying scandal that tears through her community, the relentless pressure and casual cruelty of the social media age, and the awakening of mysterious telekinetic powers that rise alongside her adolescence.

seasons.description: Justin Hartley returns for reliable Sunday-night missing-persons action across CBS and Paramount+.
seasons.overview: Lone-wolf survivalist Colter Shaw roams the country as a "reward seeker," using his expert tracking skills to help private citizens and law enforcement solve all manner of mysteries while contending with his own fractured family.

seasons.description: Maria Sten steps out of Reacher's shadow in a punchy Chicago private investigator spinoff.
seasons.overview: Frances Neagley is a private investigator in Chicago. When she learns that a beloved friend from her past has been killed in a suspicious accident, she becomes hell bent on justice. Using everything she's learned from Jack Reacher and her time as a member of the 110 Special Investigators, Neagley puts herself on a dangerous path to uncover a menacing evil.

seasons.description: Peter Krause and Hope Davis headline NBC's snappy family-of-agents drama earning 87% Rotten Tomatoes.
seasons.overview: A family of law enforcement agents bridges personal differences and crosses professional boundaries as they tackle cases for the FBI, US Marshals, Secret Service and Department of Justice. After a seemingly cut-and-dry case turns into a deadly conspiracy, they must use the expertise from a lifetime of protecting civilians and politicians to protect one another and bring the killer to justice … even if it means betraying their sworn code.

seasons.description: Social media edits propelled this 2004 Catholic schoolgirl horror drama to #1 on Netflix.
seasons.overview: After a dance-team initiation goes awry, a group of badly behaved Catholic school girls begin having prophetic visions that set off mass hysteria in their town.

seasons.description: Ben Barnes and Joe Freeman keep the Stephen King thriller moving on MGM+ Sundays.
seasons.overview: Luke Ellis, a 12-year-old genius, is kidnapped and awakens at The Institute, a facility full of children who all got there the same way he did, and all of whom possess unusual abilities. Former police officer Tim Jamieson's story and Luke’s are destined to collide.

seasons.description: Anthony Mackie and Jamie Dornan clash across Europe in Apple TV's sleek heist thriller.
seasons.overview: A disgraced FBI agent and an American career criminal play a zero-sum game of cat and mouse across Europe. At the center of it all is the daring, epic raid on a bank vault deep beneath the streets of Zurich.

seasons.description: Amy Poehler and Hugh Laurie anchor a breezy Greek archaeological caper from Michael Schur.
seasons.overview: Follows four women who work at an archeological dig in Greece. When the team uncovers a long-buried secret with the potential to rewrite history, they find themselves at the center of a high-stakes international conspiracy.

seasons.description: Park Min-young and Yook Sung-jae spark slow-burn office chemistry in Prime Video's brand-new rom-com.
seasons.overview: A false accusation threatens a deputy manager's job as she navigates corporate rivalries alongside a kindly intern and a director who sees her potential.
